title: K-flat derived comparison for concrete tensor pullback
statement: The concrete tensor pullback functor admits a total left derived functor with comparison invertible on K-flat complexes.

proof.text: Use the canonical exact inverse-image module functor. Apply K-flat pullback preservation to the adjunction-unit ringed-space map and transport along the inverse-image/tensor-pullback comparison to obtain K-flat inverse images.

Construct extension of scalars as the sectionwise extendScalars functor followed by module sheafification, and prove additivity. The supplied object and morphism equations give a natural isomorphism from inverse image followed by this extension to P. Exact inverse image and changeOfRings_kFlat_quasiIso therefore show that P preserves quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes.

Represent homotopy objects by complexes and resolve them by exists_isKFlatResolution. Surjectivity of the quotient on morphisms transfers quasi-isomorphism preservation to the homotopy functor F=P.mapHomotopyCategory followed by Qh.

Use the right fraction calculus and two-out-of-three for quasi-isomorphisms. The resolving-class essential-constancy theorem and Stacks-to-Kan bridge give pointwise right Kan extensions. Assemble them using Mathlib totalLeftDerived. At a K-flat complex, uniqueness of limit cones identifies its counit with the invertible identity leg of the resolving cone. This needs no triangulated exactness assertion for the derived functor.

proof_origin.place: Tag 06XN, dual resolving-class argument; Mathlib pointwise Kan-extension assembly and uniqueness. For concrete inverse image and extension of scalars, Tags 06YC, 06YJ and 06YT.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_tensorPullback_leftDerived
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))]
    (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))
    (h : ∀ M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y),
      P.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u}
        (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap g.hom.base X.sheaf Y.sheaf ⟨g.hom.c⟩)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule g.hom.base Y.sheaf M))
    (hm : ∀ {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)} (a : M ⟶ N),
      P.map a = eqToHom (h M) ≫ SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u}
        (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap g.hom.base X.sheaf Y.sheaf ⟨g.hom.c⟩)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule g.hom.base Y.sheaf M)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap g.hom.base Y.sheaf M a) ≫
        eqToHom (h N).symm)
    [P.Additive] :
    ∃ (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)))
      (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
        P.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh),
      L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ∧
      (∀ K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)) ℤ,
        K.IsKFlatTensor → IsIso
          (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)))
